title: Settings accordion: add one-line summary text to collapsed sections so operators know what each section contains
goal: The Settings screen has many accordion/collapsible panel sections (ai_provider, default_network_scope, default_scan_profile, integrations, notifications, threat_intel, instance, engagement_siem, engagement_jira, engagement_cicd) that are collapsed by default. When collapsed, operators only see the section title with no indication of current state or what's inside. Add a one-line status/summary text next to each collapsed section header showing: (1) current configured state (e.g. 'AI Provider: ChatGPT connected', 'Default scope: 192.168.1.0/24', 'Jira: not configured'), or (2) if unconfigured, a 5-word description of what the section controls (e.g. 'Set default scan target range'). This prevents operators from having to open every panel to find what they need.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Settings screen shows collapsed accordion panels with only a title. Operators cannot determine which sections are configured, which need attention, or what each section does without opening each one individually. This wastes time in enterprise deployments where Settings is visited to check configuration state.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Settings collapsed sections have no summary — operators must open each panel to understand configuration state.
